- Redactions at HEAD: subscription/quota mechanics, /usage plumbing,
  verbatim conversational quotes, and private-service references removed
  across ~60 docs; API spend figures and all design/ruling attributions

  behavior_pilot/README.md index, LEDGER.md/ARC2_HANDOFF.md symlinks,
  CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml).
- Licensing: data/panel-v5 LICENSE (Apache-2.0) + NOTICE for the
  ingested ai-character-index v5 bench; specs remain CC0 with upstream
  licenses.
- Fixes: trace_check.py cwd-independence; orphan prompt declarations in
  both graph_v2 configs; .venv_clingo untracked (.gitignore .venv*/);
  corpus_exclusions.py second D1 entry for the re-translated
  l1108_1367_n014 artifact (fabricated permission from Commentary),
  ruled same-defect by the project owner 2026-08-31.
- Renames: DECISIONS_FOR_MATT.md -> SCOPE_DECISIONS.md,
  CONVERGENCE_REVIEW_FOR_MATT.md -> CONVERGENCE_REVIEW.md,
  spotcheck_matt_result.json -> spotcheck_owner_result.json.
- Both suites green at this state: walkthrough 1,341 passed / 8 skipped;
  semi-formal-experiment 2,270 passed / 1 skipped; check_model exit 0.
- Committed --no-verify: the pre-commit guard hook overflows argv on
  11k staged paths; the guard itself was run by hand at this exact
  staged state and is GREEN (8/8 watched files at review points).
  Hook fix (staged-list via file, not argv) queued as follow-up.
